subject: APAC service upkeep: staged kernel & driver refresh (Sep 24 maintenance window)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@acme-analytics.com>, ops@acme-analytics.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 13:00:00 +0000
Subject: APAC service upkeep: staged kernel & driver refresh (Sep 24 maintenance window)

Hi Sam / Acme ops team,

I wanted to let you know about a scheduled maintenance window for our APAC cluster on Sept 24, 2026. This will be a staged kernel and GPU driver refresh across availability zones to address a memory fragmentation issue we've observed at scale. We are planning rolling restarts with automated health checks so customer-facing endpoints remain available, but you may see short (30–90s) reconnections to the API during each node cutover.

High level:
- Window: 2026-09-24 02:00–06:00 UTC (staged per AZ)
- Expected customer impact: brief reconnects per shard (30–90s), no long-term data loss
- Reason: mitigate memory fragmentation and enable newer driver optimizations for throughput
- Rollout: blue/green style, one AZ at a time with canary traffic and automatic rollback on error
- Contact: outages@redwood.ai (on-call) and this thread for account coordination

Attachments: maintenance plan and post-maint checklist included.

Please reply if you have any blackout constraints or if you'd like us to shift the window. If we don't hear concerns by EOD Wed (2026-09-22), we'll proceed as scheduled and share live status updates.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Partner Success Manager, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Attachments:
- 2026-09-24-apac-maintenance-plan.pdf (pdf)
- post-maint-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@acme-analytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@acme-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: APAC service upkeep: staged kernel & driver refresh (Sep 24 maintenance window)

Thanks for the heads-up, Tessa — appreciate the detailed plan. A couple quick questions from our side: 

- Can you confirm whether rate-limited streaming sessions will reconnect automatically or require clients to resume? Our ingestion pipeline uses long-lived streams (gRPC).
- We have a customer-facing runbook that calls out a blackout window for Sept 24 03:30–04:30 UTC for a regulatory sync. Can you guarantee no restarts in the primary AZ during that exact hour?

If those are okay, we'll be fine with the window. If not, we may need the primary AZ to be scheduled outside that hour.

—Sam
Sam Lee
SRE Lead, Acme Analytics
sam.lee@acme-analytics.com

Subject: Re: APAC service upkeep: staged kernel & driver refresh (Sep 24 maintenance window)

Hi Sam — great questions, thanks. Short answers below and pasted into the plan for visibility.

- Streaming sessions: gRPC long-lived streams will be gracefully reconnected by our edge layer. Clients should implement retry/resume semantics; we surface resume tokens where applicable. For canonical guidance we've added a two-paragraph section in the attached plan under "Client recommendations."
- Blackout hour: we can guarantee no planned restart in the "primary" AZ during 03:30–04:30 UTC. We'll shift the primary AZ cutover to 04:45 UTC and perform the other AZs before/after as per canary results.

We'll update the maintenance plan PDF and deliver a final confirmation by 2026-09-22 23:59 UTC. During the window we'll post progress updates to the shared status page and the support channel. If anything unexpected happens we'll execute our rollback policy.

Appreciate the quick reply — looping Hannah and Jonas so engineering and ops are aligned for the adjusted schedule.

Best,
Tessa

Subject: Internal: post-maintenance follow-up & customer verification plan (APAC Sept 24)

Team,

Following the customer alignment with Acme, here are the immediate follow-up actions for post-maintenance verification and customer outreach: 

1) Run the post-maint checklist (attached) within 30 minutes of each AZ cutover. Mark pass/fail and capture logs in the maintenance runbook.
2) Assign an SRE to monitor Acme's runbook steps during the blackout hour we reserved; primary contact: Jonas.
3) Coordinate a verification call with Acme at 2026-09-24 07:30 UTC to confirm no residual reconnect errors (15 min). Tessa to set calendar invite.
4) If any customer-facing error rate spike >1% sustained for 5 min, escalate to incident bridge and execute rollback.

I'll update the internal ticket INF-1293 with the verification artifacts and attach the final maintenance plan once Tessa uploads it.

Laura Bennett
